title: Engaging Tweens in Reading Through Teen Book Clubs and Subscription Boxes
summary: Discover the best teen book clubs and subscription boxes to engage tweens in reading in 2026. Fun, interactive options to keep kids reading all year long!
body_markdown: More than just a book-of-the-month club, ABOXOFSTORIES is committed to bringing some of the best reads out there. With only 10% of all books getting classified as bestsellers, this is a clever new book box that uses book-savvy algorithms to source those unclassified stellar reads that the masses love. Each box brings 4 amazing novels, guarantees no duplicates, and contributes a portion of all proceeds to the World Literacy Foundation.
